new.exam_name: UP Police Constable (Uttar Pradesh Police Constable Recruitment)
new.aliases: UPPRPB Constable; UPPBPB Constable; UP Police Sipahi; UP Constable and Jail Warder; UP Police Bharti
new.marking: +2 per correct answer (negative marking not confirmed)
new.eligibility: Class 12 pass (appearing candidates not eligible). Age 18-22 years for men and 18-25 for women (general category, as on 1 July 2025 for the 2025 cycle); relaxations exist for SC/ST/OBC, UP government employees and ex-servicemen. Height: men 168 cm (160 cm ST), women 152 cm (147 cm ST); men's chest 79-84 cm (5 cm expansion). Reservation benefits are for UP residents.
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper of 150 questions for 300 marks (2 marks each) in 2 hours, covering General Knowledge, General Hindi, Numerical and Mental Ability, Mental Aptitude, Intelligence and Reasoning. Minimum marks to qualify: 30% UR, 25% EWS/OBC, 20% SC/ST.
new.selection_process: Written exam (OMR) → Document verification & Physical Standard Test (height, chest) → Physical Efficiency Test (run: men 4.8 km in 25 min, women 2.4 km in 14 min; qualifying) → Merit list on written marks → Medical exam & character verification
new.remarks: One Time Registration (OTR) on the UPPRPB portal is needed before applying. Posts and age limits change every notification; confirm on uppbpb.gov.in.

applicants.note: 2025 recruitment (notified 31 Dec 2025), written exam 8-10 June 2026. 28,86,797 applied as reported by PTI/ThePrint and Careers360; total figure not explicitly attributed, but day-1 attendance (7,23,540 of 9,62,832) was given by UPPRPB, and the board DG put about 4.81 lakh candidates per shift (6 shifts), consistent with ~28.9 lakh.

vacancies.note: Total across Constable Civil Police, PAC, Armed Police, Special Security Force, Women Battalion, Mounted Police and Jail Warder posts, notified 31 Dec 2025 (Constable Direct Recruitment 2025).

new.notes: Cycle: Constable Direct Recruitment 2025 (notification 31 Dec 2025, applications to 30 Jan 2026, exam 8-10 June 2026, PET Sept-Oct 2026, final result 14 Oct 2026 per UPPRPB notice list). Official advertisement PDF could not be opened; eligibility, fee, pattern and qualifying marks are from FreeJobAlert/Careers360 summaries of it. Fee conflict: Careers360 and FreeJobAlert say Rs 500/400; Free Press Journal says Rs 400 general and no fee SC/ST (not used). Age: Careers360 says board lowered max age to 22 (men)/25 (women); a separate age-relaxation notice exists on the board site. Physical standards (height/chest) are from Physics Wallah, not the notification. Negative marking (0.25) appeared only in a search snippet, not confirmed.

new.exam_name: UP Police SI (Uttar Pradesh Police Sub-Inspector Recruitment)
new.aliases: UPPRPB SI; UP SI Civil Police; UP Daroga; UP Police Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Age 21-28 years (general category); relaxations exist for reserved categories. Height: men 168 cm (160 cm ST), women 152 cm (147 cm ST); men's chest 79-84 cm with 5 cm expansion; women minimum 40 kg. Reservation benefits are for UP residents.
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper of 160 questions in four sections of 40 each (General Hindi; Law/Constitution and General Knowledge; Numerical and Mental Ability; Mental Aptitude, Intelligence and Reasoning), 2 hours.
new.selection_process: Written exam → Document verification & Physical Standard Test → Physical Efficiency Test (run: men 4.8 km in 28 min, women 2.4 km in 16 min; qualifying) → Merit list → Medical exam
new.remarks: One Time Registration on the UPPRPB portal is needed. The 2025 cycle covers SI Civil Police, Platoon Commander PAC and equivalent posts; confirm current status on uppbpb.gov.in.

applicants.note: Careers360 citing an official UPPRPB statement: 15,72,261 forms received; 15,75,760 after modification/fee window closed 15 Sept 2025.

vacancies.note: Total SI Civil Police and equivalent posts (incl. Platoon Commander PAC etc.), notification 12 Aug 2025.

new.notes: Cycle: SI Direct Recruitment 2025 (notification 12 Aug 2025, applications to 11 Sept 2025). Official notice PDF (uppbpb.gov.in/FilesUploaded/Notice/SI_vigyapti_2025...pdf) was too large to open. Section names come from the general pattern described by CareerIndia/Careers360 and should be checked. Fee (reported elsewhere as Rs 500 general / Rs 400 SC/ST), age reference date (reported 1 July 2025), marking (+2.5, no negative reported) and exam dates (reported 14-15 March 2026, DV/PST June 2026) appeared only in search snippets of coaching sites and were not verified, so left blank. Physical standards and PET timings from Physics Wallah. Medical exam listed by Careers360 among selection stages.

new.exam_name: Bihar Police Constable (CSBC Bihar Police Constable Recruitment)
new.aliases: CSBC Constable; Bihar Sipahi Bharti; Bihar Police Sipahi; CSBC Bihar Police and BSAP Constable
new.eligibility: Class 12 (Intermediate) pass, or Maulvi/Shastri/Acharya or equivalent recognised by the Bihar government. Age (2025 cycle): general 18-25; OBC up to 27 (men)/28 (women); SC/ST up to 30; other relaxations exist. Height: men 165 cm (General/BC), 160 cm (EBC/SC/ST); women 155 cm. Men's chest 81-86 cm (79-84 cm SC/ST). Reservation, including 35% for women, is for Bihar residents.
new.application_fee: Rs. 675/- (Rs. 180/- for SC/ST, women and transgender candidates of Bihar)
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper of 100 questions for 100 marks in 2 hours at Class 10 (Bihar Board) level: Hindi, English, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, General Knowledge and Current Affairs. Qualifying (30% minimum).
new.selection_process: Written exam (qualifying) → Physical Standard Test (height, chest) → Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks: run 1.6 km men / 1 km women, shot put, high jump) → Merit list → Document verification → Medical exam
new.remarks: PET is called at about five times the vacancies. CSBC also runs separate drives for Driver Constable, Special Branch and Prohibition Constable; check csbc.bihar.gov.in.

applicants.note: IANS report quoting the CSBC chairman at the final result (27 May 2026); 99,690 shortlisted for PET, 19,838 selected.

vacancies.note: Advt. No. 01/2025, Constable in Bihar Police and Bihar Special Armed Police (6,717 for women per Free Press Journal).

new.notes: Cycle: Advt. 01/2025 (advertised 11 Mar 2025, written exam 16 Jul-3 Aug 2025 per CSBC site, final result 27 May 2026). Last date conflicts: 18 April vs 25 April 2025 (extension). Physical standards, PET events and 'written is qualifying' are from Physics Wallah; Careers360 says the final merit uses written plus physical marks, so merit basis should be checked in the official advertisement (not opened). Age figures from Free Press Journal without a reference date. 35% women's reservation for Bihar domicile per CSBC notice of 02-09-2025 listed on the CSBC homepage. Other news figures: 17,87,720 (Patrika) and 16,73,586 eligible (FPJ) - not used.

new.exam_name: Bihar Police SI (BPSSC Bihar Police Sub-Inspector Recruitment)
new.aliases: BPSSC SI; Bihar Daroga; Bihar Police Daroga Bharti; Police Sub-Inspector Bihar
new.eligibility: Graduation from a recognised university by 1 Aug 2025. Minimum age 20 (on 1 Aug 2025); maximum (on 1 Aug 2024) 37 for unreserved men, 40 for unreserved women and BC/EBC, 42 for SC/ST and third gender. Height: men 165 cm (UR/BC), 160 cm (EBC/SC/ST); women 155 cm. Men's chest 81/86 cm (79/84 cm SC/ST); women at least 48 kg. Reservation, including 35% for women, is for Bihar residents.
new.paper_pattern: Prelims: one objective paper of 100 questions for 200 marks in 2 hours on General Knowledge and Current Affairs; 30% minimum; 0.2 marks cut per wrong answer. Candidates up to 20 times the vacancies go to the Mains.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective, qualifying) → Mains: Paper 1 General Hindi (qualifying, 30%) + Paper 2 General Studies (200 marks) → Physical Efficiency Test & PST (qualifying: run men 1.6 km in 6:30 / women 1 km in 6 min, high jump, long jump, shot put) → Document verification & medical → Merit on Mains marks
new.remarks: Final merit is based only on Mains marks; PET is pass/fail. BPSSC cancelled the 2025-cycle Mains on 23 Sept 2026, so check bpssc.bihar.gov.in for the re-exam.

applicants.note: Careers360 citing the BPSSC prelims result notice (16 Mar 2026) for Advt. 05/2025; prelims held 18 and 21 Jan 2026.

vacancies.note: Advt. No. 05/2025, Police Sub-Inspector (Level 6), 614 reserved for women.

new.notes: Eligibility, fee, pattern, physical standards and PET read from the official Hindi advertisement (Advt. 05/2025, last date 26-10-2025). Mains held 27 May 2026, result 19 Jun 2026 (10,759 for PET per Patna Press), then BPSSC notice of 23-09-2026 says the Mains written exam was cancelled. Mains qualifiers conflict: 31,876 (Careers360) vs 35,857 (Patna Press). Medical stage per advertisement section 11.

new.exam_name: Maharashtra Police Bharti (Maharashtra Police Constable Recruitment)
new.aliases: Maharashtra Police Shipai Bharti; Police Constable Maharashtra; Mahapolice Bharti; SRPF Constable; Karagruh Shipai
new.eligibility: Class 12 (HSC) pass. Age 18-28 years (open category); reserved categories get relaxation, and the 2025 drive gave a one-time chance to those who crossed the age limit in 2022-2023. Height: men 165 cm, women 155 cm. Applicants should be residents of Maharashtra (as reported).
new.paper_pattern: Written test of 100 objective questions for 100 marks in 90 minutes, in Marathi: Mathematics, General Knowledge and Current Affairs, Intellectual (reasoning) test and Marathi Grammar. Minimum 40% to qualify.
new.selection_process: Physical Standard Test (height, chest) → Physical test (50 marks: men 1600 m run, 100 m run, shot put; women 800 m run, 100 m run, shot put; min 50%) → Written exam (100 marks, called at 1:10 of vacancies) → Driving/skill test for Driver and Bandsman → Document verification & medical
new.remarks: Recruitment is run unit-wise (district/commissionerate) through one state portal; candidates apply to one unit per post. Confirm dates on mahapolice.gov.in.

vacancies.note: Government Resolution of 20 Aug 2025: Police Constable 12,399; Driver 234; Bandsman 25; Armed Police (SRPF) Constable 2,393; Prison Constable 580 (vacancies of 2024 and 2025).

new.notes: Cycle: Police Bharti 2024-25 (GR 20 Aug 2025; applications Nov 2025, extended to 7 Dec 2025). GR confirms posts, fee, OMR written exam and one-time age relief. Height, PET events and 1:10 ratio from Mahabharti (aggregator); written pattern from Physics Wallah. Age 18-28 from Free Press Journal (PW FAQ says 18-25 - conflict). Domicile from Physics Wallah only. Applicants: no figure found; the official recruitment portal (policerecruitment2025.mahait.org) had an expired certificate and could not be opened. Written exam date not found.

new.exam_name: Rajasthan Police Constable (Rajasthan Police Constable Recruitment)
new.aliases: Rajasthan Police Sipahi; Rajasthan Constable GD; Rajasthan Police Constable Bharti
new.eligibility: Class 12 pass and a valid RSSB Common Eligibility Test (Senior Secondary level) score with at least 40% (35% SC/ST). new.paper_pattern: Objective written test of 150 marks (as reported) on Reasoning and Computer basics, General Knowledge/Science/Current Affairs, and Rajasthan GK. Question count, time and negative marking not confirmed.

new.remarks: A CET (Senior Secondary) pass from RSSB is needed before you can apply. Posts are split district-wise and by TSP/non-TSP areas.

applicants.note: PTI report quoting the ADG (Recruitment and Promotion Board); written exam 13-14 Sept 2025.

A 2026 cycle was not confirmed. Medical stage from Free Press Journal.

new.exam_name: WB Police Constable (WBPRB West Bengal Police Constable Recruitment)
new.aliases: WBPRB Constable; West Bengal Police Constable; WBP Constable; WBP Lady Constable
new.eligibility: Madhyamik (Class 10) pass. Age 18-30 years (as on 1 Jan 2024 for the 2024 drive); relaxations for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC-A/B (3 yrs) and others. Must speak, read and write Bengali (except residents of Darjeeling and Kalimpong hill sub-divisions). Height: men 167 cm (160 cm for Gorkha, Garhwali, Rajbanshi, ST), women 160 cm (152 cm); men's chest 78/83 cm (76/81 cm); minimum weights apply.
new.application_fee: Rs. 170/- (Rs. 150/- + Rs. 20/- processing; SC/ST of West Bengal pay only Rs. 20/-)
new.paper_pattern: One OMR paper of 85 objective questions for 85 marks in 1 hour: General Awareness and GK 25, English 10, Elementary Mathematics (Madhyamik level) 25, Reasoning 25. 1/4 mark cut per wrong answer; question paper in Bengali and Nepali.
new.selection_process: Written exam (85 marks) → Physical Measurement Test (qualifying) → Physical Efficiency Test (men 1600 m in 6 min 30 s, women 800 m in 4 min; qualifying) → Interview (15 marks) → Medical exam
new.remarks: Merit is written plus interview marks out of 100. Kolkata Police runs its own constable recruitment through the same board.

vacancies.note: Constables in West Bengal Police - 2024: 8,212 male + 3,537 female (revised notice WBPRB/NOTICE-2024/16). A revised vacancy position for the same 11,749 posts was issued 12 Aug 2026 after OBC list changes.

new.notes: Latest completed cycle is 'Constables in West Bengal Police - 2024' (applications 7 Mar-5 Apr 2024, written exam 30 Nov 2025, PMT/PET from 8 Jan 2026, interview Jan 2026, final result 24 Sept 2026). No 2025/2026 WBP constable drive is listed on the board site. All eligibility, fee, pattern and standards are from the official 'Information to Applicants' PDF. Applicant numbers not found on the board site or in news.

new.remarks: One common recruitment fills Grade II Police Constable, Jail Warder and Fireman posts; candidates give post preferences. Confirm the official notification at tnusrb.tn.gov.in.

new.exam_name: Gujarat Lokrakshak (GPRB Gujarat Police Lokrakshak Recruitment)
new.aliases: Gujarat LRD; Lokrakshak Dal; Gujarat Police Constable; GPRB LRD; Unarmed/Armed Police Constable; SRPF Constable Gujarat; Jail Sepoy
new.test_date: Physical test January; written exam June
new.eligibility: Class 12 (Higher Secondary) pass. Age 18-33 years (general); relaxation of 5 years for general women and reserved men, 10 years for reserved women (max 45), plus ex-servicemen rules. Reservation only for original residents of Gujarat. Must know Gujarati or Hindi and basic computer use. Height: men 165 cm (162 cm for ST of Gujarat), chest 79/84 cm; women 155 cm (150 cm ST).
new.application_fee: Rs. 100/- (no fee for EWS, SC, ST, SEBC and ex-servicemen)
new.paper_pattern: Objective MCQ test of 200 questions for 200 marks in 3 hours. Part A (80): Reasoning and Data Interpretation 30, Quantitative Aptitude 30, Gujarati comprehension 20. Part B (120): Constitution 30, Current Affairs/Science/GK 40, History, Culture and Geography of Gujarat and India 50. 40% needed in each part; 0.25 cut per wrong or blank answer (option E = not attempted, no penalty).
new.selection_process: Physical Efficiency Test (run: men 5000 m in 25 min, women 1600 m in 9 min 30 s; qualifying) → Physical Standard Test (height, chest) → Written MCQ test (200 marks) + bonus marks (NCC C, RRU/NFSU, sports) → Document verification → Medical exam
new.remarks: The physical test comes first and is pass/fail; merit is the written score plus any bonus marks. One form can cover both the PSI and Lokrakshak cadres.

vacancies.note: Lokrakshak cadre in Advt. GPRB/202526/1: Unarmed Constable 6,942; Armed Constable 2,458; Jail Sepoy 300 (men) + 31 (women); SRPF Constable 3,002. The same advertisement had 858 PSI-cadre posts (total 13,591).

new.notes: Cycle: Advt. GPRB/202526/1 (applications 3-23 Dec 2025 on OJAS; physical test from 21 Jan 2026; physical result 2 Apr 2026; written exam 14 Jun 2026; DV list 14 Aug 2026). All details from the official Gujarati advertisement. Age range born 23/12/1992 to 23/12/2007. Board notices of 29 Aug and 20/24 Nov 2026 mention a new upcoming Class-3 advertisement including LRD - check for the next cycle. Applicant numbers not found; web search budget ran out before news could be searched.
